text:
```yaml
name: Playwright E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - dev
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - dev

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build code
      run: npm run build

    - name: Copy built code to js-dist
      run: cp -r dist js-dist

    - name: Run e2e tests
      run: npm run test:e2e -- --timeout=600000

    - name: Upload test report
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
      with:
        name: 'Playwright E2E Tests'
        path: 'e2e/report.xml'
        reporter: 'junit'
        fail-on-error: true
        fail-on-empty: false
```
